sentences.text_target: The afternoon schedule is very busy for the office staff.
sentences.phonetic: /ði ˈɑːftənuːn ˈʃɛduːl ɪz ˈvɛri ˈbɪzi fɔː ði ˈɒfɪs stɑːf/
sentences.text_native: L'emploi du temps de l'après-midi est très chargé pour le personnel du bureau.

sentences.text_target: Mark arrives early to prepare the large meeting room.
sentences.phonetic: /mɑːk əˈraɪvz ˈɜːli tuː prɪˈpɛə ðə lɑːʤ ˈmiːtɪŋ ruːm/
sentences.text_native: Mark arrive en avance pour préparer la grande salle de réunion.

sentences.text_target: He walks to his desk and puts his heavy folder down.
sentences.phonetic: /hi wɔːks tuː hɪz dɛsk ænd pʊts hɪz ˈhɛvi ˈfəʊldə daʊn/
sentences.text_native: Il marche jusqu'à son bureau et pose son dossier lourd.

sentences.text_target: A blue notebook and some clean paper rest on the wooden table.
sentences.phonetic: /ə bluː ˈnəʊtbʊk ænd sʌm kliːn ˈpeɪpə rɛst ɒn ðə ˈwʊdn ˈteɪbl/
sentences.text_native: Un carnet bleu et du papier propre reposent sur la table en bois.

sentences.text_target: He places a black pen beside every single chair.
sentences.phonetic: /hi ˈpleɪsɪz ə blæk pɛn bɪˈsaɪd ˈɛvri ˈsɪŋgl ʧɛə/
sentences.text_native: Il place un stylo noir à côté de chaque chaise.

sentences.text_target: The clock on the wall shows two o'clock.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə klɒk ɒn ðə wɔːl ʃəʊz tuː əˈklɒk/
sentences.text_native: L'horloge sur le mur indique deux heures.

sentences.text_target: Other members of the department slowly enter the room.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈʌðə ˈmɛmbəz ɒv ðə dɪˈpɑːtmənt ˈsləʊli ˈɛntə ðə ruːm/
sentences.text_native: D'autres membres du service entrent lentement dans la pièce.

sentences.text_target: Friendly colleagues greet each other with a warm smile.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈfrɛndli ˈkɒliːgz griːt iːʧ ˈʌðə wɪð ə wɔːm smaɪl/
sentences.text_native: Des collègues sympathiques se saluent avec un sourire chaleureux.

sentences.text_target: The strict manager closes the heavy wooden door.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə strɪkt ˈmænɪʤə ˈkləʊzɪz ðə ˈhɛvi ˈwʊdn dɔː/
sentences.text_native: Le manager strict ferme la lourde porte en bois.

sentences.text_target: Everyone finds a seat around the central furniture.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈɛvrɪwʌn faɪndz ə siːt əˈraʊnd ðə ˈsɛntrəl ˈfɜːnɪʧə/
sentences.text_native: Tout le monde trouve une place autour du mobilier central.

sentences.text_target: Mark opens his laptop computer to display the presentation.
sentences.phonetic: /mɑːk ˈəʊpənz hɪz ˈlæptɒp kəmˈpjuːtə tuː dɪˈspleɪ ðə ˌprɛzɛnˈteɪʃən/
sentences.text_native: Mark ouvre son ordinateur portable pour afficher la présentation.

sentences.text_target: Soft light comes through the tall glass window.
sentences.phonetic: /sɒft laɪt kʌmz θruː ðə tɔːl glɑːs ˈwɪndəʊ/
sentences.text_native: Une lumière douce entre par la grande fenêtre en verre.

sentences.text_target: They need to review an important commercial document.
sentences.phonetic: /ðeɪ niːd tuː rɪˈvjuː ən ɪmˈpɔːtənt kəˈmɜːʃəl ˈdɒkjʊmənt/
sentences.text_native: Ils doivent examiner un document commercial important.

sentences.text_target: The printer on the floor produced twenty paper copies.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈprɪntə ɒn ðə flɔː prəˈdjuːst ˈtwɛnti ˈpeɪpə ˈkɒpiːz/
sentences.text_native: L'imprimante sur le sol a produit vingt copies papier.

sentences.text_target: Mark hands one report to the person on his right.
sentences.phonetic: /mɑːk hændz wʌn rɪˈpɔːt tuː ðə ˈpɜːsn ɒn hɪz raɪt/
sentences.text_native: Mark remet un rapport à la personne sur sa droite.

sentences.text_target: That person passes the remaining sheets to the next colleague.
sentences.phonetic: /ðæt ˈpɜːsn ˈpɑːsɪz ðə rɪˈmeɪnɪŋ ʃiːts tuː ðə nɛkst ˈkɒliːg/
sentences.text_native: Cette personne passe les feuilles restantes au collègue suivant.

sentences.text_target: The group begins to discuss the current business goal.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə gruːp bɪˈgɪnz tuː dɪˈskʌs ðə ˈkʌrənt ˈbɪznɪs gəʊl/
sentences.text_native: Le groupe commence à discuter de l'objectif commercial actuel.

sentences.text_target: A smart employee points out a difficult problem.
sentences.phonetic: /ə smɑːt ˈɪmplɔɪiː pɔɪnts aʊt ə ˈdɪfɪkəlt ˈprɒbləm/
sentences.text_native: Un employé intelligent souligne un problème difficile.

sentences.text_target: Everyone listens carefully while the speaker explains the steps.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈɛvrɪwʌn ˈlɪsnz ˈkeəfʊli waɪl ðə ˈspiːkə ɪksˈpleɪnz ðə stɛps/
sentences.text_native: Tout le monde écoute attentivement pendant que l'intervenant explique les étapes.

sentences.text_target: Numbers and statistics appear on the large visual chart.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈnʌmbəz ænd stəˈtɪstɪks əˈpɪə ɒn ðə lɑːʤ ˈvɪzjʊəl ʧɑːt/
sentences.text_native: Des chiffres et des statistiques apparaissent sur le grand tableau visuel.

sentences.text_target: The team hopes for a clear increase in sales.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə tiːm həʊps fɔː ə klɪə ˈɪnkriːs ɪn seɪlz/
sentences.text_native: L'équipe espère une nette augmentation des ventes.

sentences.text_target: Someone asks a smart question about the financial plan.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈsʌmwʌn ɑːsks ə smɑːt ˈkwɛsʧən əˈbaʊt ðə fɪˈnænʃəl plæn/
sentences.text_native: Quelqu'un pose une question intelligente concernant le plan financier.

sentences.text_target: The boss provides a logical solution after brief thought.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə bɒs prəˈvaɪdz ə ˈlɒʤɪkəl səˈluːʃən ˈɑːftə briːf θɔːt/
sentences.text_native: Le patron apporte une solution logique après une brève réflexion.

sentences.text_target: All members agree with the new strategic idea.
sentences.phonetic: /ɔːl ˈmɛmbəz əˈgriː wɪð ðə njuː strəˈtiːʤɪk aɪˈdɪə/
sentences.text_native: Tous les membres sont d'accord avec la nouvelle idée stratégique.

sentences.text_target: They write important notes inside their personal notebooks.
sentences.phonetic: /ðeɪ raɪt ɪmˈpɔːtənt nəʊts ˈɪnsaɪd ðeɪə ˈpɜːsənl ˈnəʊtbʊks/
sentences.text_native: Ils écrivent des notes importantes dans leurs carnets personnels.

sentences.text_target: The successful discussion produces a strong final strategy.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə səkˈsɛsfʊl dɪˈskʌʃən ˈprɒdjuːsɪz ə strɒŋ ˈfaɪnl ˈstrætɪʤi/
sentences.text_native: La discussion fructueuse produit une stratégie finale solide.

sentences.text_target: They prepare for a better future in the company.
sentences.phonetic: /ðeɪ prɪˈpɛə fɔː ə ˈbɛtə ˈfjuːʧə ɪn ðə ˈkʌmpəni/
sentences.text_native: Ils se préparent à un avenir meilleur dans l'entreprise.

sentences.text_target: The productive meeting finally stops at four o'clock.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə prəˈdʌktɪv ˈmiːtɪŋ ˈfaɪnəli stɒps æt fɔː əˈklɒk/
sentences.text_native: La réunion productive s'arrête enfin à quatre heures.

sentences.text_target: Colleagues pack their personal belongings and shut their computers.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈkɒliːgz pæk ðeɪə ˈpɜːsənl bɪˈlɒŋɪz ænd ʃʌt ðeɪə kəmˈpjuːtəz/
sentences.text_native: Les collègues rangent leurs affaires personnelles et éteignent leurs ordinateurs.

sentences.text_target: Everyone leaves the quiet room with a ready mindset.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈɛvrɪwʌn liːvz ðə ˈkwaɪət ruːm wɪð ə ˈrɛdi ˈmaɪndˌsɛt/
sentences.text_native: Tout le monde quitte la pièce calme avec un esprit prêt.
